title: chore(console): move the objectui pin 12dc7b47c340 → 616df6598b42, past the filterableFields reader's removal (objectui#13169)
body:
Fixes #24749
Clause-②: no

This PR moves the console pin from `12dc7b47c340` to `616df6598b42`: objectui `main` at `616df6598b429d2b3687301a2041198928e68971`. That commit carries `cbac9d7dde` (objectstack-ai/objectui#13169, the removal of objectui's last `filterableFields` reader, objectui#13118). It is the newest objectui `main` commit at or after `cbac9d7dde` that was green at the move. With it, the Console Pin Gate builds the console at `main` again, after #24721 retired `ListViewSchema.filterableFields` (AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist step 4).

This PR is not a release act. The Version Packages PR is not touched, and no release workflow is dispatched. No objectui source changed, and no `.github/workflows/**` or `scripts/build-console.sh` change is in it. The F1 re-test at the new pin is not in this PR; that is the epic seat's call (#15194).

**Tier:** not governed. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-24749-console-pin-cbac9d7` at `5b8a7dbee5`: "0 of 5 path(s) hit the register (7 surfaces govern objectstack) ... NOT governed", exit 0. Size: 5 files, +91 / -8.

## The red, reproduced on the base and gone at the new pin

- **Base.** This branch was cut from `origin/main` `9d13b5fc83`, with `.objectui-sha` = `12dc7b47c340`. The console build there, run the way the job runs it (below), fails: lock VERDICT `command-exit 1`; the client closure build exits 0, then `bash scripts/build-console.sh` exits 1 after 222 s. objectui's dependency build stops at `Failed: @object-ui/plugin-list#build` (24 of 30 tasks done). Its declaration build reports exactly two type errors, the two the diagnosis names:
  - `src/ListView.tsx(4656,58): error TS2339: Property 'length' does not exist on type '{ '[REMOVED] Key retired: run `os validate` for its migration.': never; }'.`
  - `src/ListView.tsx(4657,27): error TS2769: No overload matches this call.`

  `grep -c 'error TS'` over the log: 2. That is the same package and step as CI's annotation on run 39384364728 (Console Pin Gate): "command (.cache/objectui-12dc7b47c340/packages/plugin-list) pnpm run build exited (1)".
- **New pin.** At this PR's head, the same build exits 0. objectui's dependency build runs 34 of 34 tasks, 0 cached. `@object-ui/plugin-list` builds its declarations ("Declaration files built in 11295ms") and finishes ("built in 11.70s"). The console's own `tsc && vite build` passes ("8961 modules transformed"). `grep -c 'error TS'` over the log: 0.

## Choosing the pin

- **Green, read at the move.** REST `repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/commits/SHA/check-runs`, every page, read by this session at 2026-10-20T07:41:25Z. The bump ran at about 07:48Z, with objectui `origin/main` at `186b78d8f347` (fetched just before the bump).

  | objectui `main` commit | check-runs at the move | verdict |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | `186b78d8f347` (tip) | 95: 58 success, 3 skipped, **34 in progress** | still running, so passed over. Re-read at 08:01Z: 99 runs: 88 success, 3 skipped, **2 failure** (`Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard 6/8)`), 6 in progress, so it is now red as well |
  | **`616df6598b42`** | **29 completed: 27 success, 2 skipped, 0 failure** | **green: the target** (re-read at 08:01Z: unchanged) |

  `616df6598b42` was never a push tip. The queue landed it with `186b78d8` 18 s later, so all its runs are `merge_group` runs on `gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-13177-157694c7b…`: `CI` (Build & E2E, Type Check, Test 16 shards, dist pins, Build Docs), `Lint`, `Repo Gates`, `Governed Surface Guard`, `Changeset Presence`. All 5 workflow runs concluded `success`. Five app check suites (vercel, fly-io, claude, cloudflare-workers-and-pages, objectstack-fleet) are queued with 0 check runs.

  For the record, the older commits in the window at the same read: `157694c7b186` 1 cancelled (`Repo Gates`) and 6 in progress; `4c36eab58b1a` 1 in progress; `91b658a75d64` 2 failure (`Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard 6/8)`); `5dbc6a579287` 3 cancelled (`Lint`, `Repo Gates`, `Bundle Analysis`); `cbac9d7ddedb` 99 runs: 96 success, 3 skipped. objectui `main` moved on to `961b69f97` (`f48a4d554`, `961b69f97`) after the move. This PR does not re-choose.
- **The bump.** `OBJECTUI_ROOT=SCRATCH_CLONE bash scripts/bump-objectui.sh --no-commit 616df6598b429d2b3687301a2041198928e68971`, exit 0. It printed "12dc7b47c340..616df6598b42 walks completely" and "objectui pin: 12dc7b47c340 → 616df6598b42 (on origin/main)". SCRATCH_CLONE is a full (non-shallow) clone of objectui from GitHub in the session scratchpad. ⛔ No shared `../objectui` checkout was written. Every objectui read for the bump, the manifest and the lockstep record came from that scratch clone or from the build trees made from it. The shared checkout is shallow, so it could not walk the range.
- **Ancestry,** in that clone (`--is-shallow-repository` false), each against `616df6598b42`:
  - `cbac9d7dde` is an ancestor: exit 0;
  - `0b36ffa8cc5c` (objectui#13132, the eleven stale live specs): exit 0;
  - `fe11eb12e578` (objectui#13042, the `referenceVia` type half in `$select`): exit 0;
  - the old pin `12dc7b47c340`: exit 0;
  - control, the reverse (`616df6598b42` an ancestor of `12dc7b47c340`): exit 1.

  Range: 32 non-merge commits.
- **objectui's own objectstack pin** did not move in this range: `.objectstack-sha` = `f4755a68a797` at both ends.
- **What the range brings in.** These are the 32 objectui PRs #13079 through #13177. Among them are the ones triage named:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#13169 (`cbac9d7dd`, objectui#13118);
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#13170 (`d05f33b2e`, the CSV-declared saved mapping, objectui#13156);
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#13167 (`427e59c9e`, the unnamed RLS policy, objectui#13113);
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#13158 (`a57d80afe`, an ungrouped list asks for `nameField`, objectui#13116);
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#13168 (`96036bdd9`, the backfill checkbox wait, objectui#13120).

## The console build path, end to end

Each step is run as `ci.yml`'s `console-pin` job runs it, read off the job and not edited. The heavy steps ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, and each exit code was captured before any pipe. This is a shared box, so wall-clock figures are shared-box readings. Deviations from the CI job:
- `--concurrency=2` for the client closure and for objectui's dependency build (`OBJECTUI_DEPS_BUILD_CMD`), for the container's memory budget;
- `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`;
- `OBJECTUI_ROOT` names the full scratch clone, where CI shallow-clones;
- the cache restore/save steps do not exist locally, so `CACHE_HIT` is empty.

**Final run, at this PR's head `5b8a7dbee5`.** That is the branch merged with `origin/main` `6b222464ce`, which brought spec changes into the packed packages. The build tree `.cache/objectui-616df6598b42` and `packages/console/dist` were deleted first.

| step | command | exit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| install | `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` | 0 |
| closure + build | `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client... --concurrency=2` (36/36), then `bash scripts/build-console.sh` (485 s). Lock VERDICT `command-exit 0`, held 790 s | 0 |
| assert | the job's "Assert a real Console dist is in place" checks, `CACHE_HIT` empty: "Console dist present (65580 KB, via scripts/build-console.sh) from objectui@616df6598b42" | 0 |
| stamp | `pnpm check:console-sha`: "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@616df6598b42)." | 0 |
| injection | `pnpm check:console-injection --require-stamp`: self-test 100 assertions, then "@objectstack/spec: the dist carries this tree's copy, and not the published one." | 0 |
| manifest | `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`: 107 components, sha256 `d1fde278ffd6…`. The committed pair is byte-identical (`git status --porcelain`: 0 lines) | 0 |
| manifest check | `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-616df6598b42 node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: present, intact, recorded at the live pin `616df6598b42`, `@object-ui 17.7.0` | 0 |
| lockstep | `pnpm check:sdui-lockstep`: byte-identical to objectui@616df6598b42 over 214 grammar lines, 25 diagnostic codes, the `not-a-container` predicate | 0 |

**`build-console.sh`'s `.objectstack-sha` branch ran, in this order** (build log):
1. "objectui@616df6598b42 installs @objectstack/client @objectstack/core @objectstack/formula @objectstack/lint @objectstack/sdui-parser @objectstack/spec @objectstack/types by commit — building them here..." (turbo 36/36, cached);
2. "Building objectui's own @objectstack/* at its .objectstack-sha f4755a68a797, the reference the spec assertion judges this bundle against..." (from the machine's pin store);
3. "OBJECTSTACK_ROOT is set: packing @objectstack/* from /home/user/objectstack-issue-24749, standing in for the pin f4755a68a797.", "pack 7 package(s): 15.4s", then "node_modules/.cache/objectstack now holds ... from /home/user/objectstack-issue-24749 (5b8a7dbee5c8)";
4. the frozen install: "Lockfile is up to date, resolution step is skipped", "Done in 6.8s";
5. objectui's dependency build, 34/34 tasks, 0 cached, then the console's `tsc && vite build`: "8961 modules transformed.";
6. the closing checks:
   - "Bundle canary 'import/jobs' present";
   - "Single-zod canary: exactly one zod version literal {major:4,minor:6,patch:7}" (2262 `assets/*.js` read);
   - "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it (vendored: @objectstack/spec of objectui's own build of objectstack f4755a68a797)";
   - "Shipped the tracked sdui.manifest.json (recorded at objectui@616df6598b42, this pin).";
   - "@objectstack/console dist ready (65580 KB) from objectui@616df6598b42".

**All seven `@objectstack/*` packages objectui installs are this tree's,** read off the build tree after the install at `5b8a7dbee5`:
- `node_modules/.cache/objectstack/.stamp.json`: `source: external`, `root` this worktree, `sha` = `5b8a7dbee5c8…`, `dirty: false`, all seven at `18.0.0-next.5`.
- `node_modules/.pnpm`: 7 `@objectstack` entries, all of the `@objectstack+NAME@file+.objectstack-pin+NAME…` form.
- Each installed package's `dist/` against `packages/NAME/dist/`: `diff -rq` exit 0 for all seven (spec, core, types, client, formula, sdui-parser, lint). Control: the installed spec's `dist` against `packages/core/dist` exits 1.
- The build tree's `pnpm-lock.yaml` is byte-identical to the one committed at `616df6598b42` (`cmp` exit 0). It has 0 registry-resolved `@objectstack/*` keys and 14 `file:` keys. Control for the pattern: objectui's lockfile at `0707b4ae3712` counts 14 registry-resolved keys.

**The in-build injection assertion is NOT vacuous at this pin.** At `616df6598b42` it found a witness on each side:
- "16 of 22 injected-only descriptions are in the bundle";
- "all 10 pin-only descriptions are absent".

So no independent measurement is owed. A cross-check anyway, `grep -rlF` over the bundle's `assets/*.js`, with counts of files in this tree's `packages/spec/dist` and in the `f4755a68a797` reference spec's `dist` in brackets:
- "NOT EXECUTED by this runtime, and publish REJECTS the key" [18 / 0]: 1 bundle file;
- the stale "NOT EXECUTED in 17.x, and publish REJECTS the key" [0 / 18]: 0 bundle files.

**Earlier runs:**
- At `1ad970cafe` (the bump commit, before the manifest regeneration and the merge): `build-console.sh` exit 0 after 465 s, lock VERDICT 0, the same branch order, "dist ready (65580 KB)", "16 of 17 injected-only descriptions are in the bundle". It warned "Shipped the tracked sdui.manifest.json, but its record names objectui@12dc7b47c340", as expected before the regeneration. That run's build tree produced the committed manifest pair and lockstep record.
- After the merge, `origin/main` moved to `c56115bf96` (#24797, #24554, #24805). None of those three touches the seven packed packages, `.objectui-sha`, the SDUI files or the console build scripts (`git diff --name-only` filter: 0 paths). So the console readings above hold for the inputs at current `main`.

No input is removed. The old manifest names `filterableFields` nowhere (0 hits), so the retirement moves nothing here.

## CI

- **The Console Pin Gate does not run on this PR or in the merge queue.** `ci.yml`'s two speeds apply: the `console-pin` job's `if:` excludes `pull_request` and `merge_group`. So the **pre-merge full battery is NOT MEASURED**, and the local run above is the pre-merge reading.
- **The CI proof is `main`'s first full-battery run after the merge.** This PR changes `.objectui-sha`, so the console-dist cache key misses, and that run builds the console fresh at `616df6598b42`. The dispatching seat reads it. If it is red, it is a `main` red this card owns.
- The fast set (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Build Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard and the rest) runs on this PR as usual.
